notes.subject: karim hol
notes.rationale: כרו em i wok bilong karim hol; hia em i min ol i wokim plan bilong bagarapim man

notes.subject: אשר לא כתורתך
notes.rationale: Sampela i lukim olsem hol i no long Tora; sampela olsem ol man hepi i no bihainim Tora

notes.subject: שיחות
notes.rationale: Tok bilong hol bilong traiim man — namba liklik namel long Tanakh

translation: Ol man hepi i karim tupela hol long graun bilong traiim mi — ol ⟨i⟩ tok olgeta samting we i no stap long Tora bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: tupela hol long graun bilong traiim man
i stap long Tora bilong yu
